entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-25
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • WarningsConfiguration.ShouldUseSameServiceProvider boxes every entry #39819
  • CoreOptionsExtension rebuilds the default WarningsConfiguration on every clone #39818
  • ExpressionTreeFuncletizer.VisitMethodCall never returns its rented State arrays #39817
  • Querying a TPC base type with a JSON complex property throws #39814
  • Three Cosmos structural-equality tests fail on Cosmos DB Emulator 2.14.29 (Windows CI) #39809
  • [v11.0.0 Regression] FromSql crashes when stored procedure returns zero row #39804
  • Invalid SQL when composing `Where`/`OrderBy` after `Take`/`Skip` over `GroupBy` #39801
    12.0.0
  • Add support for AddOrUpdate (Upsert via SaveChanges) #39800
    Backlog
  • Incorrect argument forwarding in metadata builders, Cosmos paging and relational helpers #39798

Closed

  • MinBy/MaxBy lowering does not skip null keys as LINQ-to-Objects does #39276
    12.0-preview1
  • Programmatic Scaffold-Migration Broken After Updating from 8.0.15 to 9.0.4 #36016
    12.0-preview1
  • dotnet ef dbcontext scaffold on Mac creates line ending differences #29948
  • Compiled query support for ExecuteUpdate/ExecuteDelete #28722
  • Update/Insert/Delete or ignore #19508
    Backlog

PullRequests

Created

  • Compare WarningsConfiguration behaviors without boxing #39822
    community-contribution
  • Share the default WarningsConfiguration in CoreOptionsExtension #39821
    community-contribution
  • Return pooled argument states in funcletizer VisitMethodCall #39820
    community-contribution
  • [release/11.0] Don't validate JSON complex collections for identity resolution ordering #39816
  • Fix querying a TPC base type with a JSON complex property #39815
    community-contribution
  • [release/9.0]: Bump Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.EntityFrameworkCore from 8.0.31 to 8.0.34 #39813
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/9.0]: Bump Grpc.AspNetCore from 2.84.0 to 2.85.0 #39812
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/9.0]: Bump BenchmarkDotNet and 2 others #39811
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/9.0]: Bump Azure.ResourceManager.CosmosDB and 3 others #39810
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/9.0]: Bump Azure.Identity and 3 others #39808
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #39807
  • [release/11.0] Fix SQL Server JSON_CONTAINS type handling #39806
    Servicing-consider
  • [release/11.0] Make MinBy over subquery test deterministic #39805
    Servicing-consider, tell-mode
  • Translate captured IQueryable variables to common table expressions #39803
    community-contribution
  • Fix argument forwarding in metadata builders, paging and relational helpers #39799
    community-contribution
  • Prefer equality in boolean comparisons #39797
    breaking-change, community-contribution
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/11.0' => 'main' #39796

Merged

  • Throw the enum conversion error for out-of-range numeric strings #39794
    community-contribution
  • Only apply SqliteParameter.Size to string and binary values #39793
    community-contribution
  • Support nullable enums in SqliteDataReader.GetFieldValue<T> #39792
    community-contribution
  • Don't lose a millisecond when binding DateTime and TimeOnly as REAL in Microsoft.Data.Sqlite #39791
    community-contribution
  • Fix MinBy/MaxBy null-key handling with index-friendly selection #39653
    community-contribution, api-review
  • Scaffold against a new snapshot instance when the shared one is finalized #39784
    community-contribution
  • Run Helix tests on Azure Linux 4 hosts #39802
  • Reset the pending indent in IndentedStringBuilder.Clear #39795
    community-contribution
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'release/11.0' #39747

Updated

  • Prototype bulk import API (DbSet.ImportFromAsync) (#27333) #39437
    community-contribution
  • [release/11.0] Prevent data loss when DetectChanges runs before saving JSON complex collections #39778
  • Update StyleCop.Analyzers to 1.3.180 #39753
  • Don't leave the context in a bad state when tracking an entity fails #39614
    community-contribution
  • Translate LINQ CountBy #39604
    community-contribution
  • Throw when same-named DbParameters are hard-coded in FromSql/SqlQuery SQL #39593
    breaking-change, community-contribution
  • Translate primitive collections projected through set operations #39561
    community-contribution
  • Fix enum.ToString() projection on SQL Server to use bounded string type mapping (#39667) #39676
    community-contribution
  • Do not use null when padding parameter collection buckets #39756
    community-contribution
  • Throw for proxy navigations whose accessors cannot be overridden #39591
    community-contribution
  • Place the model snapshot in --output-dir when it is specified #39565
    community-contribution
  • Translate SelectMany over a grouping by flattening its rows #39602
    community-contribution
  • Translate JSON_VALUE, JSON_QUERY and json_extract #39789
    community-contribution
  • Avoid repeated nullable scalar subqueries in comparisons #39788
    community-contribution
  • Translate more SQL Server COALESCE expressions to ISNULL safely #39790
    community-contribution
  • Count NULL as a value in Distinct().Count() over a grouping #39766
    community-contribution
